systems.tiers: source of the bulletin's county tables on schools, classrooms, enrollment, teachers, facilities and students with disability, for ECE, primary, JSE and SSE

note: The bulletin's education chapter reprints tables from the 2019/2020 Annual School Census report and says nothing of how school records are kept; census only, no fact. The chapter's introduction and every line naming schools, students or the Ministry of Education were read; the tables and the other chapters were searched, not read end to end.
